rows.message: CACHE_HOST is read with no default, and none of ledger's deployment files sets it (docker-compose.yml)
rows.evidence: every deployment file of the service was read for the names it sets; a value given outside the files (a secret store, a console, the shell) is what would make this wrong
rows.fix: set CACHE_HOST where ledger is deployed, or give the read a default

rows.message: LEDGER_REGION is read with no default, and none of ledger's deployment files sets it (docker-compose.yml); LEDGER_ZONE, set in docker-compose.yml and read nowhere, is likely the same setting renamed
rows.evidence: every deployment file of the service was read for the names it sets; a value given outside the files (a secret store, a console, the shell) is what would make this wrong
rows.fix: one setting renamed on one side: read LEDGER_ZONE, or set LEDGER_REGION where LEDGER_ZONE is set

config-not-set.why: doppler run in Dockerfile hands settings in when it runs, which no file read names
